name: bigalesso-arcade
description: BIGALESSO GAMES – cabinato arcade 3D in Three.js con gioco pixel-art giocabile

scripts.docker:prebuilt: npm run build:prod && docker build -f Dockerfile.prebuilt -t bigalesso-arcade:latest .
scripts.desktop: cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm start
scripts.desktop:dist: cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dist
